title: From Dallas: City Architecture & JFK Museum Highlights Tour
includes: Oswald Rooming House Museum entry fee (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the rich tapestry of Dallas on this full-day, 7-hour guided tour. Delve into the city’s fascinating history and architectural marvels, starting from Founders Plaza with stunning downtown views. Discover the John Neely Bryan Cabin, the city's oldest structure, and visit the Old Red Museum. Reflect at the JFK Memorial Plaza and explore Dealey Plaza, a landmark of American history. Marvel at the Pioneer Plaza's impressive bronze sculptures and the modern design of Dallas City Hall. Experience the vibrant culture of Highland Park and the bustling McKinney Avenue, along with the serene Klyde Warren Park and the energetic Deep Ellum. This tour is ideal for first-time visitors, families, and history buffs.

- Comprehensive 7-hour guided city tour of Dallas
- Explore historic sites like Dealey Plaza and the JFK Memorial
- Visit the vibrant Dallas Arts District and Highland Park
- Relax at Klyde Warren Park and experience Deep Ellum's energy
